title: Research Grants on University Ecosystems
institution: Council for the Development of Social Science Research in Africa (CODESRIA)
about: CODESRIA invites proposals from researchers affiliated with African universities and research institutions for research grants on university ecosystems, including higher education, gender and academic freedom. Applications are submitted through the CODESRIA portal by 16 January 2027.
requirements: Affiliation with a recognised African higher education or research institution, with an affiliation or endorsement letter
Diaspora scholars may apply in collaboration with a colleague at an African-based institution
Individual or collaborative proposals (teams of 3 to 5 members)

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
